name: Mountain Lion Blood
summary: Across Hillsbrad and Alterac, Mountain Lion Blood draws Apothecary Lydon’s interest. In Tarren Mill, Lydon seeks fresh blood to make the Royal Apothecary Society’s dreaded Elixir of Pain.

sections.title: Reagent of the Hills
sections.body: Mountain lions prowl the highlands and foothills of Hillsbrad and Alterac. Hunters prize their pelts and claws, while the Forsaken of the Royal Apothecary Society seek the blood in their veins. Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill believes fresh mountain lion blood can form the base of a potent brew meant to bring misery to the living.

sections.title: Fueling the New Plague
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon’s experiments in Tarren Mill support the Royal Apothecary Society’s work to perfect the Forsaken’s New Plague. Lydon gathers blood from vigorous wild beasts to refine a concoction called the Elixir of Pain, testing how local organic compounds can be turned against the enemies of the Dark Lady.

faq.q: What is Mountain Lion Blood used for?
aliases: what is mountain lion blood for
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill needs ten vials of Mountain Lion Blood to make the Elixir of Pain. The Royal Apothecary Society studies new diseases.

faq.q: Where can Mountain Lion Blood be collected?
aliases: where to find mountain lion blood
faq.answer: Mountain Lion Blood comes from lions hunting across the Hillsbrad Foothills and the snowy crags of the nearby Alterac Mountains.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Lydon specifically want wild cat blood?
aliases: why does lydon want lion blood
faq.answer: Lydon believes the vital fluids of hardy, aggressive mountain lions can form the basis of a toxic brew that brings great pain to Hillsbrad’s living inhabitants.

faq.q: Is Mountain Lion Blood useful for alchemy crafting recipes?
aliases: can alchemists use mountain lion blood
faq.answer: No. Mountain Lion Blood is an experimental reagent for Apothecary Lydon’s work, not an ingredient in standard alchemy recipes.

angles.text: As an Undead, each vial you collect helps the Royal Apothecary Society develop biological weapons to secure Lordaeron for the Forsaken.
As a member of the Horde, gathering beast reagents around Tarren Mill strengthens your presence against hostile human enclaves in Hillsbrad.
